description: Canonical RFC 8785 hashes of the melt/semantic-draft-1 document fixtures, computed by the Python schema package. They are kept separate from fixtures/valid/document-hashes.json so the v0.1 suite stays unchanged; the generated TypeScript and Swift models of protocol/generated verify them beside the Python implementation and scripts/verify_canonical_hashes.mjs (SPEC.md section 18.1, RFC 001).
